name: Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)
summary: Approximate Bayesian posteriors by constructing a Markov chain with the desired stationary distribution.
summary_zh: 构造以目标后验为平稳分布的马尔可夫链，以样本近似积分或不确定性。
core_idea: Use reversible or invariant stochastic transition kernels to explore posterior probability.
innovation: Enables distribution-level inverse uncertainty quantification beyond a single point estimate.
limitations: Large PDE forward-model cost can make chains expensive.
Convergence/mixing must be diagnosed rather than assumed.

start_here.why: Inverse-problem-centered treatment of posterior computation and sampling.
start_here.focus: Posterior inference and Monte Carlo computation.
